column1: # Active ISO 4217 List One codes, based on the SIX maintenance-agency list published 2026-01-01.
# word_re is the Ukrainian word-form regex fragment matched after an amount (empty = none).
# trailing_symbol: also match a bare "<digits> <symbol>" pattern.
# minor_digits is the ISO minor-unit exponent; 0 is also used for N.A. fund/metal/test codes.
# Order matters: earlier currencies win when patterns overlap.
